```{r}
    by = "kultur"
  ) 

## TEST

table1_updated_test <- result_all %>%
  select(-kulturartengruppe) %>%  # only keep kultur (we'll join the updated values)
  right_join(
    table2 %>% select(kultur, kulturartengruppe),
    by = "kultur"
  ) %>% select(kultur, kulturartengruppe, deckung_flora)

clean_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws() %>%
    gsub("_gps", "", .)  # remove '_gps' suffix if not meaningful
}

table1 <- table1 %>%
  mutate(kultur_clean = clean_name(kultur))

table2 <- table2 %>%
  mutate(kultur_clean = clean_name(kultur))

table1_filled <- table1 %>%
  left_join(table2, by = "kultur_clean", suffix = c("", "_new")) %>%
  mutate(
    kulturartengruppe = coalesce(kulturartengruppe, kulturartengruppe_new)
  ) %>%
  select(kultur, kulturartengruppe)
```

# Statistics
```{r}
## Statistical Prep - DRY Version (Fixed)

# Define the groups you want to analyze
target_groups <- c("1", "2", "5", "6", "7", "8", "9")

# Define the variables you want statistics for
vars_to_summarise <- c("artenzahl_flora", "deckung_flora", "bluehende_pflanzen", 
                       "deckung_kultur", "hnv_taxa")

# Function to compute statistics
compute_stats <- function(data) { 
  data %>%
    group_by(group, jahr) %>%
    summarise(
      across(all_of(vars_to_summarise),
             list(
               mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
               median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
               sd = ~ifelse(length(na.omit(.x)) > 1, sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
               min = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
               max = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
             ),
             .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::complete(group, jahr)
}

# Function to create ordered factor levels for group_jahr
create_ordered_levels <- function(group_jahr_vector) {
  ord_df <- tibble(gj = unique(as.character(group_jahr_vector))) %>%
    mutate(
      prefix = str_extract(gj, "^[A-Za-z]+") %>% tolower(),
      year = str_extract(gj, "\\d{4}") %>% as.integer(),
      prefix_rank = case_when(
        prefix == "k" ~ 1L,
        prefix == "m" ~ 2L,
        prefix == "b" ~ 3L,
        TRUE ~ 4L
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(is.na(year), year, prefix_rank, gj)
  
  return(ord_df$gj)
}

# Function to process each group
process_group <- function(data, group_number) {
  # Filter for specific kulturartengruppe
  filtered_data <- data %>% 
    filter(kulturartengruppe == group_number) %>%
    mutate(group_jahr = interaction(group, jahr, sep = "_", drop = TRUE))
  
  # Create ordered levels and apply them
  new_levels <- create_ordered_levels(filtered_data$group_jahr)
  filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
    mutate(group_jahr = factor(as.character(group_jahr), levels = new_levels))
  
  return(filtered_data)
}

# Process all groups and create separate dataframes
gruppe_data <- target_groups %>%
  set_names(paste0("gruppe", .)) %>%
  map(~process_group(combined, .x))

# Compute statistics for all groups - FIXED VERSION
gruppe_stats_list <- target_groups %>%
  set_names(paste0("gruppe", ., "_stats")) %>%
  map(~{
    # Filter for this specific group
    data <- combined %>% filter(kulturartengruppe == .x)
    # Compute stats
    stats <- compute_stats(data)
    # Add group_jahr and apply ordered levels
    stats <- stats %>% mutate(group_jahr = interaction(group, jahr, sep = "_"))
    new_levels <- create_ordered_levels(stats$group_jahr)
    stats %>% mutate(group_jahr = factor(as.character(group_jahr), levels = new_levels))
  })

# Extract individual dataframes for easy access
list2env(gruppe_data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
list2env(gruppe_stats_list, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# # Verify the objects exist
# cat("Created data objects:\n")
# ls(pattern = "^gruppe[0-9]$")
# cat("\nCreated stats objects:\n")
# ls(pattern = "^gruppe[0-9]_stats$")


# gruppe1, gruppe5, gruppe6, gruppe7, gruppe8, gruppe9 (filtered data with group_jahr)
# gruppe1_stats, gruppe5_stats, gruppe6_stats, gruppe7_stats, gruppe8_stats, gruppe9_stats

```

# Deckungsgrad Segetalarten [%]

## Gruppe 1

```{r}
# gruppe1_stats

# Plot
ggplot(gruppe1, aes(x = group_jahr, y = deckung_flora, fill = group)) +
  # Barplot showing mean values
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", color = "black", width = 0.4, na.rm = TRUE) +
  # Error bars for standard error
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  # Jittered points for individual observations
  geom_jitter(shape = 16, position = position_jitter(0.1), color = "black", size = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  # Median points as red diamonds
  stat_summary(fun = "median", geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 4, fill = "red", na.rm = TRUE) +
  # Line connecting group means over years
  geom_line(
    data = gruppe1_stats,
    aes(x = group_jahr, y = deckung_flora_mean, group = group, color = group),
    linewidth = 1,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  # Points for mean values on the line
  geom_point(
    data = gruppe1_stats,
    aes(x = group_jahr, y = deckung_flora_mean, color = group),
    size = 2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  # Custom colors
 scale_fill_manual(
  name = "Gruppe",
  values = c("k" = "#4682B4", "m" = "#CD9B1D", "b" = "#CDB5CD"),
  breaks = c("k", "m", "b")
) +
scale_color_manual(
  name = "Gruppe",
  values = c("k" = "#4682B4", "m" = "#CD9B1D", "b" = "#CDB5CD"),
  breaks = c("k", "m", "b")
) +
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "\nGruppe und Jahr",
    y = "Deckungsgrad Segetalarten [%]\n",
    fill = "Gruppe",
    color = "Gruppe"
  ) +
  # Theme
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

```

```{r}

# Plot

  # Barplot showing mean values
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", color = "black", width = 0.4, na.rm = TRUE) +
  # Error bars for standard error

  # Jittered points for individual observations
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
# Ensure gruppe1_means is correctly formatted
gruppe1_means <- gruppe1 %>%
  group_by(group, jahr) %>%
  summarise(mean_deckung = mean(deckung_flora, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::complete(group, jahr, fill = list(mean_deckung = NA))

# Modified ggplot code
ggplot(gruppe1, aes(x = group, y = deckung_flora, fill = group)) +
  # Barplot showing mean values
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", color = "black", width = 0.4, na.rm = TRUE) +
  # Error bars for standard error
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, linetype = 1, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  # Jittered points for individual observations
  geom_jitter(
    shape = 16, position = position_jitter(0.1), color = "black", size = 1, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  # Mean points as red diamonds
  stat_summary(
    fun = "median", geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 4, fill = "red", na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  # Line connecting mean values for each group across years
  geom_line(
    data = gruppe1_means, 
    aes(x = as.numeric(factor(jahr)), y = mean_deckung, group = group),
    color = "black", linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  # Points for mean values on the line
  geom_point(
    data = gruppe1_means, 
    aes(x = as.numeric(factor(jahr)), y = mean_deckung, group = group),
    color = "black", size = 2, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  # Facet by year
  facet_wrap(~jahr, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  # Apply colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4682B4", "#CD9B1D", "#CDB5CD")) +
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "\nHerbizidfreie Bewirtschaftung",
    y = "Deckungsgrad Segetalarten [%]\n"
  ) +
  # Theme settings
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

# HNV PLOTS

### leveling hnv; renaming hnv_wertgruppe
```{r eval=FALSE}
  combined_mutate <- combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(hnv_wertgruppe)) %>%  # Remove NA values
  mutate(hnv_wertgruppe = case_when(
    hnv_wertgruppe == "1" ~ "I",
    hnv_wertgruppe == "2" ~ "II",
    hnv_wertgruppe == "3" ~ "III",
    hnv_wertgruppe == "0" ~ "X",
    TRUE ~ hnv_wertgruppe  # Keep all other values as they are
  )) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(hnv_wertgruppe) & hnv_wertgruppe != "NA") %>% 
  mutate(
    hnv_wertgruppe = as.factor(hnv_wertgruppe),
    group = as.factor(group),
    jahr = as.factor(jahr)
  )

df <- combined_mutate

# Reorder factor levels
df$hnv_wertgruppe <- factor(df$hnv_wertgruppe, levels = c("X", "III", "II", "I"))



process_hnv_data <- function(data, gruppe_id) { 
  df <- data %>%
    filter(kulturartengruppe == gruppe_id) %>%
    mutate(
      group_jahr = interaction(group, jahr, sep = "_", drop = TRUE),
      hnv_wertgruppe = factor(hnv_wertgruppe, levels = c("X", "III", "II", "I"))
    )
  
  # Counts per HNV group, year, and group (filtered!)
  hnv_counts <- df %>%
    group_by(group, jahr, hnv_wertgruppe) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(group_jahr = interaction(group, jahr, sep = "_", drop = TRUE))
  
  # Totals per group_jahr for line geometry
  hnv_totals <- hnv_counts %>%
    group_by(group, jahr, group_jahr) %>%
    summarise(total_count = sum(count), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Order x-axis (group_jahr)
  ord_levels <- hnv_counts %>%
    distinct(group_jahr, jahr, group) %>%
    arrange(jahr, factor(group, levels = c("k", "m", "b"))) %>%
    pull(group_jahr)
  
  hnv_counts <- hnv_counts %>%
    mutate(group_jahr = factor(group_jahr, levels = ord_levels))
  
  hnv_totals <- hnv_totals %>%
    mutate(group_jahr = factor(group_jahr, levels = ord_levels))
  
  list(counts = hnv_counts, totals = hnv_totals)
}


# --- Run for kulturartengruppe 1 ---
gruppe1_results <- process_hnv_data(combined_mutate, "1")
hnv_counts_g1 <- gruppe1_results$counts
hnv_totals_g1 <- gruppe1_results$totals

# --- Run for kulturartengruppe 8 ---
gruppe8_results <- process_hnv_data(combined_mutate, "8")
hnv_counts_g8 <- gruppe8_results$counts
hnv_totals_g8 <- gruppe8_results$totals
```

# HNV Werte

```{r}
### Stats
## HNV Data Processing - DRY Version with Complete Cases

# Define the groups you want to analyze
target_groups <- c("1", "2", "5", "6", "7", "8", "9")

# Prepare combined_mutate (this only needs to be done once)
combined_mutate <- combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(hnv_wertgruppe)) %>%
  mutate(hnv_wertgruppe = case_when(
    hnv_wertgruppe == "1" ~ "I",
    hnv_wertgruppe == "2" ~ "II",
    hnv_wertgruppe == "3" ~ "III",
    hnv_wertgruppe == "0" ~ "X",
    TRUE ~ hnv_wertgruppe
  )) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(hnv_wertgruppe) & hnv_wertgruppe != "NA") %>% 
  mutate(
    hnv_wertgruppe = factor(hnv_wertgruppe, levels = c("X", "III", "II", "I")),
    group = as.factor(group),
    jahr = as.factor(jahr)
  )

# Function to process HNV data for a specific kulturartengruppe
process_hnv_data <- function(data, gruppe_id) { 
  df <- data %>%
    filter(kulturartengruppe == gruppe_id) %>%
    mutate(
      group_jahr = interaction(group, jahr, sep = "_", drop = TRUE),
      hnv_wertgruppe = factor(hnv_wertgruppe, levels = c("X", "III", "II", "I"))
    )
  
  # Counts per HNV group, year, and group
  hnv_counts <- df %>%
    group_by(group, jahr, hnv_wertgruppe, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    # Complete all combinations to add missing rows with count = 0
    complete(
      group, 
      jahr, 
      hnv_wertgruppe = factor(c("X", "III", "II", "I"), levels = c("X", "III", "II", "I")),
      fill = list(count = 0)
    ) %>%
    mutate(group_jahr = interaction(group, jahr, sep = "_", drop = TRUE))
  
  # Totals per group_jahr for line geometry
  hnv_totals <- hnv_counts %>%
    group_by(group, jahr, group_jahr) %>%
    summarise(total_count = sum(count), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Order x-axis (group_jahr)
  ord_levels <- hnv_counts %>%
    distinct(group_jahr, jahr, group) %>%
    arrange(jahr, factor(group, levels = c("k", "m", "b"))) %>%
    pull(group_jahr)
  
  hnv_counts <- hnv_counts %>%
    mutate(group_jahr = factor(group_jahr, levels = ord_levels))
  
  hnv_totals <- hnv_totals %>%
    mutate(group_jahr = factor(group_jahr, levels = ord_levels))
  
  list(counts = hnv_counts, totals = hnv_totals)
}

# Process all groups at once
hnv_results <- target_groups %>%
  set_names(paste0("gruppe", .)) %>%
  map(~process_hnv_data(combined_mutate, .x))

# Extract counts and totals for each group
hnv_counts_list <- hnv_results %>%
  map("counts") %>%
  set_names(paste0("hnv_counts_g", target_groups))

hnv_totals_list <- hnv_results %>%
  map("totals") %>%
  set_names(paste0("hnv_totals_g", target_groups))

# Export to global environment for easy access
list2env(hnv_counts_list, envir = .GlobalEnv)
list2env(hnv_totals_list, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Verify the objects exist
cat("Created HNV counts objects:\n")
print(ls(pattern = "^hnv_counts_g[0-9]$"))
cat("\nCreated HNV totals objects:\n")
print(ls(pattern = "^hnv_totals_g[0-9]$"))
```

### Plot
```{r}
years <- 2021:2025
hnv_levels <- c("NA", "X", "III", "II", "I")

jahr_hnv_levels <- as.vector(t(outer(years, hnv_levels, paste, sep = "_")))

hnv_counts_g1_line <- hnv_counts_g1 %>%
  mutate(
    hnv_wertgruppe = ifelse(is.na(hnv_wertgruppe), "NA", as.character(hnv_wertgruppe)),
    jahr_hnv = paste0(jahr, "_", hnv_wertgruppe),
    jahr_hnv = factor(jahr_hnv, levels = jahr_hnv_levels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(group, jahr_hnv) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop")
```

### Plot Alternative 2 (Kürzerer Plot)

```{r}
# --- Plot ---
years <- 2021:2025
hnv_levels <- c("X", "III", "II", "I")
jahr_hnv_levels <- as.vector(t(outer(hnv_levels, years, paste, sep = "_")))
jahr_hnv_levels <- gsub("^(.*)_(.*)$", "\\2_\\1", jahr_hnv_levels)  # flip order to Jahr_HNV

hnv_counts_g8_line <- hnv_counts_g8 %>%
  mutate(
    hnv_wertgruppe = ifelse(is.na(hnv_wertgruppe), "NA", as.character(hnv_wertgruppe)),
    jahr_hnv = paste0(jahr, "_", hnv_wertgruppe),
    jahr_hnv = factor(jahr_hnv, levels = jahr_hnv_levels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(group, jahr_hnv) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("k", "m", "b")))

# Find the last x-position with any non-zero values
last_nonzero <- hnv_counts_g8_line %>%
  group_by(jahr_hnv) %>%
  summarise(any_nonzero = any(count > 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(any_nonzero) %>%
  pull(jahr_hnv) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  tail(1)

# Filter data up to and including the last non-zero position
if (!is.null(last_nonzero) && length(last_nonzero) > 0) {
  last_level_index <- which(levels(hnv_counts_g8_line$jahr_hnv) == last_nonzero)
  cutoff_levels <- levels(hnv_counts_g8_line$jahr_hnv)[1:last_level_index]
  
  hnv_counts_g8_line <- hnv_counts_g8_line %>%
    filter(jahr_hnv %in% cutoff_levels) %>%
    mutate(jahr_hnv = factor(jahr_hnv, levels = cutoff_levels))
}

ggplot(hnv_counts_g8_line, aes(x = jahr_hnv, y = count, color = group, group = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Gruppe",
    values = c("k" = "#4682B4", "m" = "#CD9B1D", "b" = "#CDB5CD"),
    labels = c("k" = "Konventionell", "m" = "Maßnahme", "b" = "Ökologisch")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Gesamtentwicklung der HNV-Wertgruppen",
    x = "Jahr und HNV-Wertgruppe",
    y = "Anzahl"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
